evidence_seen_when_frozen.purpose: operationalize already-frozen semantic criteria against the observed GloBI column schema; not choose criteria from genetics

plant_requirement.family_rule: The plant-side taxon path must contain the focal species' exact frozen LepTraits host-family token.
plant_requirement.species_level_name_rule: Require at least two whitespace-delimited taxon-name tokens; reject names whose second token is sp., sp, spp., spp, cf., or aff.; family-only and genus-only names remain audit-only.
plant_requirement.later_taxonomic_resolution: Preserve raw plant names now. Resolve accepted names against one frozen external plant taxonomy only after the full raw capture is frozen.

deduplication.primary_host_identity_unit: unique raw species-level plant taxon name within focal Lepidoptera species
deduplication.repeated_studies: collapse for host identity; retain study titles only as provenance
